assembly_definition: An organ is assembled only when TUI launcher presence, tools/docs/functions, personal validators, Custodes validators, Throne validators, and red/blue resilience are all evidenced and verified.

tui_launcher_presence.meaning: Organ has a terminal launcher presence that returns control to the shell after command execution.

organ_tools_docs_functions.meaning: Organ has concrete docs/functions/tools needed to perform its mission.

personal_flow_validators.meaning: Validators that check work flowing through the organ.

personal_integrity_validators.meaning: Validators that check whether the organ itself behaves honestly and within authority.

custodes_organ_validators.meaning: Custodes validators attack the organ's work, authority, validator honesty, and trust chain.

throne_organ_validators.meaning: Throne validators decide whether the organ's proof counts as Imperium reality.

red_team_layer.meaning: Organ can attack its own failure modes, fake-green paths, scope leaks, and vulnerability patterns.

blue_team_layer.meaning: Organ can defend against its own red-team findings through hard gates, guardrails, and recovery paths.

stage_law: profile_baseline != duty_defined != assembly_target_defined != rule_validated != action_proven != trust_proven != throne_confirmed != organ_assembled
hard_rules: duty contract is not operational proof
TUI placeholder is not human visibility proof
personal validator pass is not Custodes trust
Custodes validator pass is not Throne crown confirmation
red-team inventory is not resilience proof until attack validators exist
blue-team inventory is not defense proof until defense validators pass
organ assembly score must not raise operational/trust/no-core-mutation scores without action receipts
